About AS Textile

A dependable textile partner for quality-led businesses.

AS Textile is based in Karachi, Pakistan, specializing in export-class textile products and bulk-quantity orders. We are currently open to new orders and welcome new contracts with quality-focused clients.

Made in Pakistan · Built for Global Buyers

Our approach to every order

We combine hands-on production oversight with a practical understanding of commercial textile requirements. Every order begins with the buyer’s specification and is managed for consistency from material selection through final inspection.

Clear communication, dependable planning, and consistent output guide the way we work with hospitality groups, retailers, distributors, and private-label buyers.
